description: This file defines the interface for a socket waiter module in C, including types, enums, function prototypes, and macros for managing socket waiters, adding/removing sockets, waiting for socket events, and waking up waiters. It facilitates waiting on multiple sockets simultaneously and handling socket readiness callbacks.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterCreate
methods.description: Creates and returns a new socket waiter for the current thread.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a socket waiter and removes all registered sockets.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterAdd
methods.description: Adds a socket to the waiter with specified interests and persistence.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterRemove
methods.description: Removes a socket from the waiter.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterWait
methods.description: Waits indefinitely on registered sockets, calling callbacks when sockets are ready.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterWaitTimed
methods.description: Waits for registered sockets with a timeout, returning the reason for exit.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterWakeUp
methods.description: Wakes up the waiter, causing it to exit wait state.
